title: A completed part sale line with an inactive part keeps its totals
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory parts {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PSDONE-01, Sell Price $20.00) and {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PSDONE-02, Sell Price $15.00) are tracked at {Location-A}.
  • Part sale {Part-sale-A} (for example P2-89) for customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL PSDONE Customer) is invoiced and sold 2 of {Part-A} and 1 of {Part-B}.
  • {Part-A} was set inactive after the invoice was created.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Part-sale-A} and read its Parts tab.
  2. Open the Finance tab and read the invoice's Summary.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Part-A} is still listed: quantity 2, $20.00, $40.00; {Part-B} 1 × $15.00.
  • Step 2: The Summary still reads Parts $55.00 ($40.00 + $15.00), unchanged by the deactivation.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S9-E1, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 6.7 (shows an invoiced part sale), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-E1: “A line that already holds a part when the part becomes inactive stays on its work order, estimate or part sale, including a completed part sale, and its totals keep calculating.”
